name: Typed Phrases
description: Phrases typed out after a fixed prefix, held, erased and replaced, with a water-blue caret.

props.name: phrases
props.description: Phrases typed one after another. The box is sized for the tallest from the start, so nothing around it moves. Screen readers get the prefix and every phrase.

props.name: mode
props.description: Type adds and removes one character at a time. Wipe reveals and hides the whole phrase behind a moving soft edge.

props.name: typeSpeed
props.description: Milliseconds per character typed, with a slight human unevenness. In wipe, sets the speed of the edge.

props.name: pause
props.description: Milliseconds a finished phrase is held before it is erased.

props.name: loop
props.description: Start again after the last phrase. Off, the last phrase stays.

props.name: caret
props.description: Show the caret: a 2px water-blue bar that holds steady while typing and blinks while waiting.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the text is scrolled into view. Off, it starts on mount.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a grid. Font, size and colour are inherited. Under reduced motion a whole phrase shows and the caret holds still.
